title: Hayden Panettiere’s ex-fiancé files for temporary guardianship of her estate on behalf of their daughter Kaya
text:
Stated Claim / Post Context:
Hayden Panettiere’s ex-fiancé files for temporary guardianship of her estate on behalf of their daughter Kaya

Wladimir Klitschko is seeking temporary guardianship of Hayden Panettiere's estate for their 11-year-old daughter as the death probe continues.

Actual Article Body:
LOS ANGELES, Calif. (CNN) — Hayden Panettiere’s former fiancé is filing for temporary guardianship of her estate.

Wladimir Klitschko is taking the legal step on behalf of their 11-year-old daughter, Kaya, who is the sole heir to her mother’s assets.

The filing pushes for immediate action, citing urgent concerns that property and valuables could be lost or mishandled.

The investigation into Panettiere’s death is ongoing.
